title: Northgate Optical Accidental Replacement Charge Worksheet
content:
The accidental replacement charge of a Northgate Optical eyewear job is calculated on the job's own charges.

**Replacement basis.** The replacement basis is the original frame charge and the original base-lens charge of the job, each less every credit already posted against it. "Original" means the charges of the original order (remake number 0); a vision plan allowance or refund already credited against either charge reduces it.

**Charge.** The accidental replacement charge is the lens design's accidental damage charge percentage — 30 percent on each design that carries accidental damage coverage — of the replacement basis, plus a replacement fitting fee of 15.00, rounded to the cent.

**Replacement clock.** The replacement percentage is set from the whole months between the replacement clock start and the day the replacement is authorized, and the replacement clock start is the dispensed date of the job.

## Order of working

The accidental replacement charge is worked out in this order: the replacement basis is first multiplied by the replacement percentage after any lowering, never below zero percent; that amount is then reduced by the card spend reduction; the replacement material surcharge and the replacement fitting fee are then added; and the result is rounded to the cent once.

| Line | Value |
|---|---|
| Replacement percentage | the lens design's accidental damage charge percentage (30 percent) |
| Lowering of the replacement percentage | 0 percentage points |
| Card spend reduction | 0 percent |
| Replacement material surcharge | 0.00 |
| Replacement fitting fee | 15.00 |
| Rounding | to the cent, once, at the end |

## Worked figures (hypothetical jobs)

**Job 1 — Northgate Premium Progressive Lenses billed to a vision plan.** Frame charge 160.00 with a 130.00 allowance credited: net 30.00. Base-lens charge 149.99 with a 54.99 allowance credited: net 95.00. Replacement basis 125.00. 125.00 multiplied by 30 percent is 37.50; adding the 15.00 fitting fee gives 52.50.

**Job 2 — Northgate Digital Freeform Progressive Lenses, private pay.** Frame charge 200.00, base-lens charge 169.99, no credits. Replacement basis 369.99. 369.99 multiplied by 30 percent is 110.997; adding 15.00 gives 125.997, rounded once to 126.00.
